rules.when: Any work on the Krunchix customer mobile app: the Expo/React Native app under frontend/apps/mobile in the Krunchix/krunchix monorepo, including features, bug fixes, UI, navigation, offline behaviour, store/release work, and its shared packages when the change is for the mobile app.
rules.why: Captain's standing rule (2026-09-16): the customer mobile app is the priority project; give it the strongest crewmate available, Fable while its quota allows, otherwise the latest Opus.

rules.when: The task is architecture, technical or product design, research, investigation, planning, a scout report, an audit, or any work that is genuinely open-ended and needs deep reasoning before code.
rules.why: Captain's standing rule (2026-09-16): Fable for architecture and research when quota is present, otherwise the latest Opus at the same effort.

rules.when: The task is a big or ambiguous multi-file feature, a risky refactor, or work that requires holding many moving parts in mind, outside the mobile app.
rules.why: Strong coding profile for big work; Sonnet takes over when Opus quota is thin.

rules.when: The task is a simple bug fix whose root cause and fix are already clear, a small well-defined change, a test addition, or a documentation update.
rules.why: Use more efficient models for well defined work.

rules.when: The task is a trivial mechanical edit such as a rote rename, formatting sweep, targeted typo fix, dependency bump with green CI, or simple file gathering.
rules.why: Cheapest fast profile when the task is narrow and low ambiguity.
